people.name: Jezebel
people.line: Queen of Israel; wife of King Ahab

translations.web: The men of his city, even the elders and the nobles who lived in his city, did as Jezebel had instructed them in the letters which she had written and sent to them.
translations.bsb: So the elders and nobles who lived in Naboth’s city did as Jezebel had instructed in the letters she had written to them.
translations.kjv: And the men of his city, even the elders and the nobles who were the inhabitants in his city, did as Jezebel had sent unto them, and as it was written in the letters which she had sent unto them.
translations.asv: And the men of his city, even the elders and the nobles who dwelt in his city, did as Jezebel had sent unto them, according as it was written in the letters which she had sent unto them.
